name: peoplelake
description: Replayable workforce ELT and historical analytics warehouse on the Cloudflare Workers Free plan (Workers, Durable Objects, R2, Apache Iceberg in Basin Catalog, Workflows), BigQuery and dbt

scripts.dev: TZ=UTC vite build && TZ=UTC wrangler dev --port 8791 --inspector-port 9241 --ip 127.0.0.1
scripts.typecheck: TZ=UTC tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker-test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.test:py: TZ=UTC uv run --project pipeline pytest pipeline/tests
scripts.deploy:dry-run: TZ=UTC vite build && TZ=UTC node scripts/render-wrangler.ts --state scripts/fixtures/prod-state.example.json --out wrangler.dry-run.jsonc && TZ=UTC node scripts/predeploy-check.ts --config wrangler.dry-run.jsonc --state scripts/fixtures/prod-state.example.json && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.dry-run.jsonc --env production --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
scripts.deploy:runner: TZ=UTC uv run --project pipeline peoplelake prod deploy-runner
scripts.prod:e2e: TZ=UTC uv run --project pipeline peoplelake prod e2e --duration 60m
scripts.eval:scenarios: TZ=UTC uv run --project pipeline peoplelake eval scenarios
scripts.eval:freshness: TZ=UTC uv run --project pipeline peoplelake eval freshness
scripts.eval:ask: TZ=UTC uv run --project pipeline peoplelake eval ask
